admission.justification: A link the reader cannot open, or one that names an issue that does not exist yet, reads as evidence and is not; the creation order is what keeps a published body from naming a target that never appears.

applicability: Every visible link in a published text, and the order in which the plan creates the issues those links name.
conditions: The destination is a page of the two public repositories, or an issue that exists when the text is written.
exclusions: Unresolved targets, which stay in the private plan only.
Local notes and scratch files, which are described in words or left out.

evidence: The plan has 36 creates before 16 edits, 16 native links and only confirmed-issue URLs; unresolved targets stay private.

statement: Visible links lead only to the two public repositories or to issues that already exist; the agent looks an issue up by its marker before creating one, and a body that named a later issue by title is updated when that issue appears.
